items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I didn't see a Jones in there

ctx.x: I happened to have the phone number, I mean the address, of where she lived in Montreal, but there was a family that lived right next door to them, also, that I knew about, and I had been trying to find her, the same as I was trying to find Michelle, and so I arrived in Toronto on a Sunday, and so I didn't have anything to do, because you know up there in Canada on a Sunday, they had the blue laws and everything was closed.

So I'm laying up in bed, and it finally dawned on me, why don't you go to the phone company and look in the Montreal phone book and see if you can find that they are still listed. So I look in the listings, and I didn't see a Jones in there, so I thought about this family that lived
